basis: Congenital absence of part of an ocular structure; isolated umbrella concept does not imply extraocular disease.
Primary cutaneous lymphoid proliferation in the T-cell lymphoma spectrum; skin origin, lymphoid-cell disease and lymphoma mechanism.
Inherited lipid metabolism disorder; associated coronary atherosclerosis is a separately diagnosed disease.
Pyrimidine metabolism defect; intellectual disability in 12/19 and seizures in 30-79%. Villous atrophy is occasional; feeding difficulty alone does not establish GI damage.
Congenital cortical and other brain malformations with developmental impairment; cerebral visual impairment reflects brain dysfunction rather than eye disease.
Loss of gingival tissue; gums and teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Skeletal ciliopathy; anal atresia and tongue hamartoma 2/2; major cardiac defects each 1/2. Pulmonary hypoplasia frequency unspecified.
Structural or functional injury of glomerular podocytes; immune mediation is not universal across this umbrella.
Neoplastic proliferation confined to breast myoepithelial tissue; breast has no axis.
Methylcobalamin metabolism defect with megaloblastic anemia; developmental impairment and epilepsy are common core manifestations (>30%). Enlargement alone does not establish liver damage.
Hereditary cerebellar degeneration and ataxia; tinnitus in 3/7 does not establish ear damage, and hypermetric saccades are cerebellar signs.
Malignancy of the uterine endometrium, a reproductive tissue outside the axes; no common extrauterine organ involvement established.
Nutritional vitamin deficiency umbrella; neurologic, hematologic and other organ injuries vary by the deficient B vitamin and are not universal.
Acquired developmental and epileptic encephalopathy directly affects brain function; acquisition alone does not imply an infectious or immune mechanism.
Congenital retinal photoreceptor synaptic dysfunction causing night blindness and visual impairment; nervous-system ancestry does not imply extraocular disease.
Progressive retinal dystrophy with severe visual loss; developmental and gait abnormalities are occasional and do not support neurologic involvement.
The supplied definition specifies lens-protein hypersensitivity with autoimmune ocular inflammation and secondary glaucoma.
STAG1-related developmental brain disorder; frequent reflux/feeding problems lack documented GI injury. Joint hypermobility in 5/16 alone does not establish locomotor damage.
Congenital or acquired renal cystic disorder; extrarenal findings of particular inherited subtypes do not apply across this umbrella.
Clonal hematopoietic neoplasm involving blood and marrow; splenic involvement shares this axis. Other tissue infiltration lacks a supported ≥30% frequency; cardiac fibrosis is rare.
Invasive fungal infection; the supplied concept establishes no specific organ site affected in at least 30%.
Complex I metabolic defect; developmental impairment and caudate atrophy 2/2. Scoliosis likely secondary to spasticity; optic atrophy <5%; adrenal dysfunction shares the metabolic axis.
Syndromic intellectual disability; clubfoot, kyphosis and congenital hip dislocation each 30-79%; strabismus 30-79%. Recurrent infections do not establish intrinsic immune damage.
Microsporidial infection characteristically causes intestinal disease with chronic diarrhea and wasting; other organ infections are occasional or rare.
Carcinoma originating in ovarian reproductive tissue; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish an endocrine-gland disorder or hormonal dysfunction.
